_comment: Branch protection for main, as reviewable code. (ADR-0037: 'pipeline definitions in version control')
Apply:  gh api -X POST repos/:owner/:repo/rulesets --input .github/rulesets/main.json
Update: gh api -X PUT  repos/:owner/:repo/rulesets/<id> --input .github/rulesets/main.json
STAGED, for the same reason CI stages are staged (ADR-0037 rider): a required
status check cannot reference a check that has never reported. Each check name
joins the list after its first run on a PR, in lockstep with the pipeline.
GitHub will NOT accept an empty required_status_checks array:
422 Invalid parameter required_status_checks: Expected at least 1 elements, got 0
So at stage 1 the rule is OMITTED ENTIRELY rather than present-and-empty. Applied
2026-08-08 as ruleset id 20592724 with pull_request + deletion + non_fast_forward.
Verified live via: gh api repos/:owner/:repo/rules/branches/main
(note: git push --dry-run does NOT evaluate rulesets and will appear to succeed
against a protected branch — do not use it to verify protection.)
STAGE 2, once the first PR run reports, add this rule back with the check names
that actually reported — start with "Standalone gates" and "Workspace checks":
gh api -X PUT repos/:owner/:repo/rulesets/20592724 --input .github/rulesets/main.json
The three protections that need no check history are active immediately:
pull request required, direct pushes blocked, force pushes blocked.
Checks to add as they come online, matching .github/workflows/pr.yml:
now          Standalone gates, Workspace checks
with eslint  (lint stage inside Workspace checks)
with contracts   contract codegen drift, openapi diff
with migrations  migration lint
with domain      domain purity
with tests       unit + use-case, integration
with authz       role-matrix suite
with machines    state-machine suite
with docker      docker build, trivy
name: main
